The moment02
UAE National Day

2 December.
The UAE turns 55.

National Day is the moment the whole country celebrates together. For MINI, it is a chance to show up with something people feel part of, talk about and share.

Our ideas turn the MINI into a canvas for Emirati creativity. Made for social first, then extended into the showroom and retail.

What guides our ideas
01

Made by Emirati hands

Local artists and craft at the centre, not as decoration.

02

The MINI as a canvas

The car itself carries the story, inside and out.

03

Social first, showroom ready

Content that lives on MINI ME and in AGMC showrooms long after 2 December.

Idea 01 · Al-Sadu collab03
Idea 01

Threads that
move us

A tribute to our heritage. A drive towards tomorrow.

The idea

We collaborate with an Emirati Al-Sadu artist to bring a traditional craft onto the MINI. Handwoven pieces and patterns dress the car inside and out, built on top of it rather than into it.

Why it works

Everything sits on top of the car, so it is quick to produce and approve. And the craft does not stay on the car: it becomes things people can see, buy and keep.

What we make

The dressed hero car, an Al-Sadu installation at the AGMC showroom, a limited collection of key covers and tote bags, an artist film and a social toolkit for MINI ME.

Idea 02 · Roof05
Idea 02

7 Emirates.
7 perspectives.

Seven artists. Seven roofs. One road.

The idea

We invite Emirati and UAE-based artists, ideally seven, one per emirate, to turn a MINI roof into their canvas. On 2 December, the finished cars drive together as one convoy.

Why it works

It platforms local creators and gives MINI ME weeks of making-of content. It scales easily: one, two or three artists work just as well as seven.

What we make

A making-of series documenting each roof as it comes to life, artist portraits, roof reveals and the 2 December convoy film.

Seven roofs, one per emirate
